cases.statement: (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ) (ha : SeqConvergesTo a A) (hb : SeqConvergesTo b B) : SeqConvergesTo (fun n => a n + b n) (A + B)
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [A1]
have hε2 : (0:ℝ) < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := ha (ε / 2) hε2
-- [S3]
obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hb (ε / 2) hε2
-- [S4]
refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
-- [S5]
show |a n + b n - (A + B)| < ε
have h1 := hN₁ n (le_of_max_le_left hn)
have h2 := hN₂ n (le_of_max_le_right hn)
have e : a n + b n - (A + B) = (a n - A) + (b n - B) := by ring
have tri : |a n + b n - (A + B)| ≤ |a n - A| + |b n - B| := by
  rw [e]
  first
  | exact abs_add_le _ _
  | exact abs_add _ _
linarith

cases.statement: (a b c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hab : ∀ n, a n ≤ b n) (hbc : ∀ n, b n ≤ c n) (ha : SeqConvergesTo a L) (hc : SeqConvergesTo c L) : SeqConvergesTo b L
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := ha ε hε
obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hc ε hε
-- [S3]
refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
have h1 := hN₁ n (le_of_max_le_left hn)
have h2 := hN₂ n (le_of_max_le_right hn)
have hb1 := hab n
have hb2 := hbc n
obtain ⟨h1l, h1r⟩ := abs_lt.mp h1
obtain ⟨h2l, h2r⟩ := abs_lt.mp h2
rw [abs_lt]
constructor <;> linarith

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ha : SeqConvergesTo a A) : SeqConvergesTo (fun n => c * a n) (c * A)
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [A1]
have hc : 0 < |c| + 1 := by positivity
have hδ : 0 < ε / (|c| + 1) := div_pos hε hc
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ha (ε / (|c| + 1)) hδ
-- [S3]
refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
show |c * a n - c * A| < ε
have hn' := hN n hn
have e : c * a n - c * A = c * (a n - A) := by ring
rw [e, abs_mul]
have h1 : |c| * |a n - A| ≤ |c| * (ε / (|c| + 1)) :=
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hn') (abs_nonneg c)
have hδeq : ε / (|c| + 1) * (|c| + 1) = ε := by
  field_simp
have h3 : |c| * (ε / (|c| + 1)) = ε - ε / (|c| + 1) := by
  linear_combination hδeq
have h2 : |c| * (ε / (|c| + 1)) < ε := by
  rw [h3]
  linarith
exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2

cases.statement: (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ) (ha : SeqConvergesTo a A) (hb : SeqConvergesTo b B) : SeqConvergesTo (fun n => a n + b n) (A + B)
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := ha ε hε
-- [S3]
obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hb ε hε
-- [S4]
refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
-- [S5]
show |a n + b n - (A + B)| < ε
have h1 := hN₁ n (le_of_max_le_left hn)
have h2 := hN₂ n (le_of_max_le_right hn)
have htri : |a n + b n - (A + B)| ≤ |a n - A| + |b n - B| := by
  have e : a n + b n - (A + B) = (a n - A) + (b n - B) := by ring
  rw [e]
  first
  | exact abs_add_le _ _
  | exact abs_add _ _
linarith

-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ε
-- [A1]
have hNpos : (0:ℝ) < (N:ℝ) := by linarith
-- [S3]
refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
show |1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) - 0| < ε
have hnN : (N:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
have h1 : 1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) < 1 / (N:ℝ) := one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hNpos (by linarith)
have h2 : 1 / (N:ℝ) < ε := by
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hNpos]
  nlinarith
rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
linarith

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (ha : SeqConvergesTo a L) : SeqConvergesTo (fun n => |a n|) |L|
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ha ε hε
-- [S3]
refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
show |(|a n| - |L|)| < ε
have h1 : |(|a n| - |L|)| ≥ |a n - L| := by
  linarith [abs_abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (a n) L]
have h2 : |a n - L| < ε := hN n hn
linarith [h1, h2]

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : SeqConverges a) : SeqBounded a
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := ha
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hL 1 (by norm_num)
-- [S3]
have h3 : ∀ n ≥ N, |a n| < |L| + 1 := by
  intro n hn
  have h1 := hN n hn
  have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (a n) L
  linarith
-- [A1]
show ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, |a n| ≤ M
-- [S4]
refine ⟨|L| + 1, fun n => ?_⟩
exact le_of_lt (h3 n (by omega))

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : SeqConverges a) : SeqCauchy a
cases.tactic_block:
-- [A1]
obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := ha
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [A2]
have hε2 : ε / 2 > 0 := half_pos hε
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hL (ε / 2) hε2
-- [S3]
refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
have h1 := hN m hm
have h2 := hN n hn
linarith

cases.statement: (a b c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hab : ∀ n, a n ≤ b n) (hbc : ∀ n, b n ≤ c n) (ha : SeqConvergesTo a L) (hc : SeqConvergesTo c L) : SeqConvergesTo b L
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hc ε hε
-- [S3]
refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
have h1 := hN n hn
have h2 := hbc n
have h3 : b n < L + ε := by
  have := (abs_lt.mp h1).2
  linarith
rw [abs_lt]
constructor <;> linarith

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h_inc : ∀ n : ℕ, a n ≤ a (n + 1)) (h_bdd : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, a n ≤ M) : SeqConverges a
cases.tactic_block:
-- [A1]
obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_bdd
have hmono : Monotone a := monotone_nat_of_le_succ h_inc
have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range a) := ⟨M, by rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; exact hM n⟩
-- [S1]
have ht := tendsto_atTop_ciSup hmono hbdd
refine ⟨⨆ i, a i, ?_⟩
rw [seqConvergesTo_iff_tendsto]
exact ht

cases.statement: : SeqConvergesTo (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) 0
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
have key : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1) - Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) = 1 / (Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1) + Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) ∧ 1 / (Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1) + Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) := by
  intro n hn
  have hn' : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have h1 : 0 < Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hn'
  have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have s1 : Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1) ^ 2 = (n:ℝ)+1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have s2 : Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) ^ 2 = (n:ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  constructor
  · rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
    linear_combination s1 - s2
  · apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le h1
    linarith
-- [S2]
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / ε ^ 2)
-- [A1]
have hε0 : ε ≠ 0 := hε.ne'
have hNpos : (0:ℝ) < (N:ℝ) := lt_trans (div_pos one_pos (pow_pos hε 2)) hN
have hN0 : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast hNpos
-- [S3]
refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
show |Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1) - Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) - 0| < ε
have hn0 : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hN0 hn
have hNn : (N:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
obtain ⟨heq, hle⟩ := key n hn0
have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNpos
have hs' : Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
have hmono : 1 / Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hs (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hNn)
have hsq : Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) ^ 2 = (N:ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hNpos.le
have h3 : 1 < ε ^ 2 * (N:ℝ) := by
  have e : ε ^ 2 * (1 / ε ^ 2) = 1 := by field_simp
  have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hN (pow_pos hε 2)
  linarith
have htpos : 0 < ε * Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := mul_pos hε hs
have ht2 : (ε * Real.sqrt (N:ℝ)) ^ 2 = ε ^ 2 * (N:ℝ) := by rw [mul_pow, hsq]
have h4 : 1 < ε * Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := by nlinarith [ht2, h3, htpos]
have hu : 1 / Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) * Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) = 1 := by field_simp
have h5 : 1 / Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) < ε := by nlinarith [hu, h4, hs]
have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1) - Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) := by
  rw [heq]
  positivity
rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hpos]
linarith [heq, hle, hmono, h5]

-- [S1]
have h2 : ∀ n : ℕ, (n:ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2:ℝ)^n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ k ih =>
    push_cast
    rw [pow_succ]
    nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2) k, (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0:ℝ) ≤ k)]
have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ((1:ℝ)/2)^n := fun n => by positivity
have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, ((1:ℝ)/2)^n ≤ 1/((n:ℝ)+1) := by
  intro n
  rw [div_pow, one_pow]
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (h2 n)
have hlim : SeqConvergesTo (fun n : ℕ => 1/((n:ℝ)+1)) 0 := by
  rw [seqConvergesTo_iff_tendsto]
  exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
-- [S2]
rw [seqConvergesTo_iff_tendsto] at hlim ⊢
exact squeeze_zero (fun n => (hpos n).le) hbound hlim

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 1 → a n = 1 / (n : ℝ)) : SeqConvergesTo a 0
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / ε)
refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
-- [A1]
have h1e : 0 < 1 / ε := one_div_pos.mpr hε
have hNpos : (0:ℝ) < (N:ℝ) := lt_trans h1e hN
have hnN : (N:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hNpos hnN
have hn1 : n ≥ 1 := by
  have : 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
  omega
rw [ha n hn1]
-- [S2]
have h0 : 0 < 1 / (n:ℝ) := one_div_pos.mpr hnpos
have h2 : 1 / (n:ℝ) ≤ 1 / (N:ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hNpos hnN
have e : 1 / ε * ε = 1 := by field_simp
have h4 : 1 < (N:ℝ) * ε := by
  have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN hε
  rw [e] at this
  linarith
have h5 : 1 / (N:ℝ) * (N:ℝ) = 1 := by field_simp
have h3 : 1 / (N:ℝ) < ε := by nlinarith [h5, h4, hNpos]
rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos h0]
linarith

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : SeqConverges a) : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, |a n| ≤ M
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := ha
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hL 1 (by norm_num)
-- [S3]
refine ⟨(Finset.range N).fold max (|L| + 1) (fun i => |a i|), fun n => ?_⟩
-- [S4]
rw [Finset.le_fold_max]
by_cases h : n < N
· right
  exact ⟨n, Finset.mem_range.mpr h, le_rfl⟩
· left
  have h1 := hN n (by omega)
  rw [abs_lt] at h1
  have h3 := neg_abs_le L
  have h4 := le_abs_self L
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

cases.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (ha : SeqConvergesTo a L) (hlt : ∀ n : ℕ, a n < 1) : L ≤ 1
cases.tactic_block:
-- [S1]
by_contra h
push_neg at h
-- [A1]
have hε : (0:ℝ) < L - 1 := by linarith
-- [S2]
obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ha (L - 1) hε
have h1 := hN N le_rfl
rw [abs_lt] at h1
obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := h1
have h2 := hlt N
have hcontra : False := by linarith
-- [S3]
exact hcontra
